LanguageData.WildShift_ScenarioIntro:
When the last pursuer vanished into the snowstorm, you heard your own breathing for the first time.

A battered drop pod has stranded you on an unnamed rimworld. All that remains are a few supplies and another shape growling beneath your skin.

Will you settle as a human, or survive as a beast? From today onward, the answer is yours to write.
